seriesName: Rex Fleet Academy: Between the Beacons
premise: The invisible physics of a safe corridor becomes visible social power: ordinary people depend on green routes, surveyors discover alternatives, brokers commoditize route knowledge, the BHA certifies evidence, the Fleet turns stewardship into structural power, and the Shards gain room wherever the public map stops being authoritative.
format: Academy science-and-culture one-off told as active instruction, demonstrations, field cases and simulation.

scienceCanon.corridor: Measured three-dimensional low-tension volume around a surveyed spine; approximately circular cross-section, normally about twice the beam of the largest certified ship.
scienceCanon.inversion: Dynamic maintenance of a workable relationship with inverse/reciprocal tension; not a hard tunnel.
scienceCanon.green: Verified local measurements support the certified envelope.
scienceCanon.red: Unsafe, unverified, or failed/insufficient sensing; unknown defaults red.
scienceCanon.extremeFailure: Extreme tension can physically shatter a beacon.

surveyCulture.fleet: Repeat empirical surveying that can progress to BHA public certification and beacon infrastructure.
surveyCulture.private: Independent empirical surveying whose routes may stay private, be privately marked, or be sold.
surveyCulture.brokers: Middlemen can resell route data to legitimate or illegitimate customers; age, provenance and limitations have commercial value.
surveyCulture.leaks: Internal BHA diagnostics can reveal why a public beacon is red and change private risk calculations without changing official status.

power: Fleet control of safe movement functions like King's-Road/Roman-road power: maintenance, certification, patrol, closure, reopening and bypass all affect trade, relief, logistics and legitimacy.

colorGrammar.green: Verge / public dependence / civilian life / colony and ecology
colorGrammar.tempest: dark purple and gold / Fleet force at the margins
colorGrammar.crimson: deep red and gold / current Fleet-aligned protective force; future rift is not present villainy
